lck-alerts-checklist__cta: BEM element marker on the CTA paragraph inside styled .lck-alerts-checklist callout; spacing via p defaults
lck-app--denied: state modifier on styled .lck-app canvas; deny marker cited by probes/e2e (access-denied surface paints via .lck-shell--minimal)
lck-badge__label: JS text target inside styled .lck-badge pill (js/app.js updates the label; chrome via .lck-badge + .lck-badge__dot)
lck-channel-status: base marker on the channel status line; state paints via --ok/--err modifiers (css/app.css), ink via .lck-muted
lck-health-card__action: BEM element marker on styled .lck-btn inside styled .lck-health-card__actions
lck-health-summary__check: BEM element marker on styled .lck-btn (check-again button; selected via #lck-check-again)
lck-reenable-channel: JS hook on styled .lck-btn; binds data-channel re-enable/test in js/settings.js
lck-test-turn-on: JS hook on styled .lck-btn; binds data-channel test+enable in js/settings.js
lck-transfer-report: dialog root marker on styled .lck-dialog; verdict styled via .lck-transfer-report__verdict
